clips.title: The story
paras: Newly awakened Forsaken gather in Deathknell, a fortified village in a secluded valley of southwestern Tirisfal Glades. Mindless Scourge, Scarlet zealots, and dangerous beasts press the settlement as the undead claim a place in Sylvanas Windrunner’s kingdom.

You enter Deathknell through a narrow gorge, sealed by elite Deathguards against intruders. Newly awakened undead first open their eyes here, north of the Silverpine border and behind jagged hills. Most Tirisfal settlements kept the human names they bore under the fallen Kingdom of Lordaeron, but the undead who claimed this town gave it a new name. The old church anchors the southern grounds, where the Forsaken hold on. North of it, the village forge and surrounding streets remain overrun by mindless Scourge zombies and feral ghouls. Local caretakers bring new arrivals into the Banshee Queen’s service.

Deathknell faces danger from every side. Night Web’s Hollow, a gold mine northwest of the village, has fallen to monstrous spiders, cutting off a resource vital to the Forsaken’s fledgling economy. Southeast of town, the Scarlet Crusade keeps an encampment in the hills, watches the pass, and trades couriers with strongholds to the east while testing the valley’s defenses. Caretakers fight the mindless undead roaming the northern ruins and gather scrap metal, tools, and supplies for newly arisen souls setting out on the long road ahead.
